description: Saves a new email as a draft in the signed-in person's Outlook Drafts folder. Does not send the message. A first call returns a preview; a second call with confirm true and that preview_id applies the change. Sign-in required.

confirm.description: false or omitted returns a preview; true applies the change identified by preview_id.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Same key on a retry replays the first save without writing twice.

preview_id.description: preview_id is the id returned by this tool's preview call. Required when confirm is true.

name: draft_outlook_email
title: Draft an Outlook email
